'''2009 US West Nationals Day 2 Ryan Freeman DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Freeman]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Freeman
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
